0: SELECT u.first_name, COUNT(*) AS user_count FROM users u JOIN users_groups ug ON u.id = ug.user_id JOIN groups g ON ug.group_id = g.id WHERE g.name = 'developers' AND EXISTS (     SELECT 1     FROM dual_factor df     WHERE df.user_id = u.id     AND df.factor_type = 'OATH' ) GROUP BY u.first_name;
1: SELECT AVG(p.preis) FROM tab_produkt p JOIN tab_kategorie k ON p.kat_id = k.kat_id WHERE k.kat_bezeichner = 'Office';

3: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PROFILE_THEME_PREFERENCES_T WHERE THEME_NAME = 'Dark Mode' AND AUTO_SWITCH = 'active';
4: SELECT u1.name AS user_with_message, COUNT(*) AS message_count FROM messages m JOIN users u1 ON m.receiver_id = u1.id JOIN users u2 ON m.sender_id = u2.id WHERE u1.id != u2.id AND u2.id IN (     SELECT user_id_a     FROM user_connections     WHERE user_id_b = u2.id     AND connection_type IN ('friend', 'collaborator', 'follower') ) GROUP BY u1.id;
5: SELECT AVG(b.used_space) FROM new_volume_backups b JOIN new_ceph_pools c ON b.volume_id = c.pool_id JOIN new_block_device_mapping dbm ON b.volume_id = dbm.volume_id JOIN new_guest_os_types os ON dbm.instance_uuid = os.instance_id WHERE os.os_type = 'x86_64';
6: SELECT      n.pref_key AS notification_type,     COUNT(*) AS total_engagements,     MAX(u.last_login) AS last_login FROM      user_patterns u JOIN      notification_engagements ne ON u.user_id = ne.user_id JOIN      user_preferences n ON u.user_id = n.user_id GROUP BY      n.user_id,      n.pref_key ORDER BY      total_engagements DESC LIMIT 5;
7: SELECT      n.notification_id,     n.message,     n.created_at,     n.is_read,     n.user_id,     n.sent_at,     p.card_last4,     p.expiration,     s.vip_status,     s.channel_settings FROM public_notification n JOIN public_user_payment_method p ON n.user_id = p.user_id JOIN public_user_settings s ON n.user_id = s.user_id WHERE s.channel_settings LIKE '%email%';
8: SELECT      item_name,     SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity FROM      item_transaction_logs JOIN      quest_reward_item_details ON item_transaction_logs.transaction_id = quest_reward_item_details.reward_id JOIN      user_item_trade_agreements ON quest_reward_item_details.mission_id = user_item_trade_agreements.mission_id GROUP BY      item_name ORDER BY      total_quantity DESC LIMIT 3;
9: SELECT AVG((SELECT AVG(julianday(reminder_sent) - julianday(appointment_date)) FROM appointment_reminder ar WHERE ar.appointment_id = a.id) / 2) AS average_time FROM appointment a WHERE a.id IN (SELECT appointment_id FROM user_appointment_attendance) AND a.status = 'completed';
10: SELECT Team.Name FROM Team JOIN TeamTravelLog ON Team.ID = TeamTravelLog.ID_Team JOIN Match ON TeamTravelLog.MatchID = Match.ID JOIN MatchDayOverview ON Match.ID = MatchDayOverview.ID_Match WHERE MatchDayOverview.MatchDate >= date('now', '-6 months') GROUP BY Team.Name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;
11: SELECT ua.user_id FROM user_activity ua JOIN test_access_log tal ON ua.user_id = tal.user_id JOIN test_audit ta ON tal.user_id = ta.user_id JOIN user_dashboard ub ON tal.user_id = ub.user_id JOIN test_tag tt ON ta.test_id = tt.test_id WHERE tt.tag_id IN (     SELECT tag_id     FROM tag     WHERE name = 'Performance' );
12: SELECT      user_id,      COUNT(*) AS login_count FROM      user_activity_logs WHERE      action = 'Login' AND ip_address IN (          SELECT ip_range FROM bot_ranges      ) GROUP BY      user_id ORDER BY      login_count DESC;
13: SELECT u.user_id FROM user u JOIN user_preference p ON u.user_id = p.user_id JOIN tag_suggestion s ON p.user_id = s.user_id JOIN tag_suggestion_vote sv ON s.suggestion_id = sv.suggestion_id WHERE sv.vote_value = 1 AND sv.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND sv.user_id = u.user_id AND sv.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND sv.created_time >= datetime('now', '-6 months') GROUP BY u.user_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 3;
14: SELECT AVG(sc.carbon_emissions) FROM warehouse_db_invoice_carrier ic JOIN warehouse_db_shipping_containers sc ON ic.invoice_id = sc.container_id JOIN warehouse_db_shipment_cost_breakdowns scd ON ic.invoice_id = scd.shipment_id JOIN warehouse_db_supplier_performance sp ON ic.invoice_id = sp.container_id WHERE scd.carrier_id = sp.supplier_id;
15: SELECT payment_method FROM (     SELECT payment_method     FROM pembelian     WHERE kode_supplier = (SELECT kode_supplier FROM supplier WHERE nama_supplier = 'CV Mega Jaya') ) ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;
16: SELECT d.ID_, d.DEPLOYMENT_TIME_ FROM ACT_RE_DEPLOYMENT d JOIN ACT_RU_DEPLOYMENT_DEPENDENCIES dd ON d.ID_ = dd.DEPENDENT_ID_ JOIN ACT_RE_PROCDEF p ON dd.DEPLOYMENT_ID_ = p.DEPLOYMENT_ID_ GROUP BY d.ID_ HAVING COUNT(*) > 10;
17: SELECT u.full_name FROM user_profile u JOIN user_fiddles f ON u.id = f.user_id WHERE f.user_id NOT IN (SELECT student_id FROM fiddle_students);
18: SELECT DISTINCT nias.name FROM network_insights_access_scopes nias JOIN network_insights_path_analyses pias ON nias.id = pias.access_scope_id JOIN vpc_endpoints ve ON pias.vpc_id = ve.vpc_id WHERE pias.status = 'successful' AND ve.endpoint_type = 'Public' AND pias.path_analysis_id IN (SELECT path_analysis_id FROM network_insights_path_analyses WHERE vpc_id IN (SELECT vpc_id FROM vpc_endpoints) GROUP BY path_analysis_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 5);
19: SELECT e.* FROM exercises e JOIN equipmentUsageLogs eul ON e.equipmentId = eul.equipmentId JOIN locations l ON eul.locationId = l.id WHERE eul.status = 'Out of stock' AND l.capacity > 0;
20: SELECT id_kategori, jenis_kategori FROM tb_kategori JOIN tb_produk ON id_kategori = id_kategori WHERE stok > 50 GROUP BY id_kategori, jenis_kategori HAVING COUNT(*) > 10;
21: SELECT reason FROM chart_delegation GROUP BY reason ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC;
22: SELECT      l.id,      l.name,      l.description,      l.organization_id,      MAX(gm.message) AS max_message FROM      leaderboard l JOIN      leaderboard_entry e ON l.id = e.leaderboard_id JOIN      game_chat_message gm ON e.game_id = gm.game_id JOIN      user u ON e.user_id = u.id JOIN      user_friendship uf ON u.id = uf.user_id2 WHERE      e.user_id IN (         SELECT u2.user_id         FROM user u1 JOIN user u2 ON u1.organization_id = u2.organization_id         WHERE u1.organization_id = l.organization_id         AND u2.user_id = u.id         AND u1.id <> u2.id         AND NOT u1.id      ) GROUP BY      l.id,      l.name,      l.description,      MAX(gm.message) ORDER BY      l.id;
23: SELECT      AD.alert_name,     COUNT(*) AS total_instances,     AVG(ai.priority_level) AS avg_priority,     MAX(ai.triggered_time) AS last_triggered_time FROM Alert_Action AA JOIN Alert_Definition AD ON AA.alert_def_id = AD.alert_def_id JOIN Alert_Instance ai ON AA.alert_id = ai.alert_id JOIN FUNCTION F ON AD.module_id = F.module_id JOIN Module M ON F.module_id = M.module_id WHERE M.module_name = 'Inventory'   AND AD.alert_id IN (       SELECT alert_id       FROM Alert_Action       WHERE action_taken = 'Resolved'         AND alert_def_id = AD.alert_def_id         AND resolved_time IS NOT NULL       GROUP BY alert_def_id       HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3     ) GROUP BY AD.alert_def_id;
24: SELECT p.project_name, COUNT(pm.user_id) AS member_count FROM projects p LEFT JOIN project_members pm ON p.id = pm.project_id GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY member_count DESC;

26: SELECT Element.ELD FROM Element JOIN ElementChecklist ON Element.ELD = ElementChecklist.ELD WHERE ElementChecklist.LastCompleted IS NOT NULL AND ElementChecklist.Status = 1;

28: SELECT     a.article_id,     a.title,     a.content,     SUM(CASE WHEN r.like_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_likes,     SUM(CASE WHEN r.share_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_shares,     s.user_id AS writer_id,     s.follower_count,     c.category_id,     c.category_name,     (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cms_article_interactions ai2 WHERE ai2.article_id = a.article_id AND ai2.user_id = s.user_id) AS writer_interactions,     (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cms_article_interactions ai3 WHERE ai3.article_id = a.article_id AND ai3.user_id = f.follower_id) AS follower_interactions FROM cms_article a JOIN cms_article_revisions r ON a.article_id = r.article_id JOIN csys_user s ON a.seller_id = s.user_id JOIN csys_user_follow f ON s.user_id = f.follower_id JOIN cms_article_category c ON a.article_id = c.article_id JOIN cms_article_categories ac ON a.article_id = ac.article_id JOIN cms_article_interactions ai ON a.article_id = ai.article_id WHERE a.system_id = 'your_system_id' GROUP BY a.article_id, a.title, a.content, s.user_id, c.category_id, c.category_name ORDER BY total_likes DESC;
29: SELECT s.name AS supplier_name, po.total_amount, wp.stock_level FROM supplier_contracts sc JOIN partner_contracts pc ON sc.id = pc.fkLogisticsPartnerId JOIN warehouse w ON wp.fkWarehouseId = w.id JOIN supplier_products sp ON sp.fkSupplierId = sc.fkSupplierId JOIN supplier_evaluation se ON se.fkSupplierId = sc.fkSupplierId JOIN supplier_feedback sf ON sf.fkSupplierId = sc.fkSupplierId JOIN warehouse_efficiency wei ON wei.fkWarehouseId = w.id JOIN supplier_lead_time_history slh ON slh.fkSupplierId = sc.fkSupplierId JOIN order_tracking ot ON ot.fkOrderId = (SELECT fkOrderId FROM ims_orderItems WHERE fkItemId = sp.fkItemId) JOIN order_feedback ofe ON ofe.fkOrderId = (SELECT fkOrderId FROM ims_orderItems WHERE fkItemId = sp.fkItemId) JOIN reorder_requests rr ON rr.fkItemId = sp.fkItemId JOIN supplier_contracts sc2 ON rr.fkSupplierId = sc2.fkSupplierId WHERE sc2.end_date >= '2025-01-01' AND slh.lead_time_days > 5;
